units: raw evaluation counts; the level-0 screen counts interpolated evaluations (one per orientation, summed with strict ones), so the counts are not strict-equivalent
true_basin: first screened candidate (R_disc: spacing-filter survivors ordered by screen score, before the quick MC) within the level's grid diameter of the truth
safe_rule: per level, at most max_broken broken at 1 degree; largest gross saving; on a tie, the smaller c

zero_counts.count: E0 old rule: voxels misclassified by the final cost (best c)
E0 C++ rule: voxels misclassified by the final cost (best c)
E0 old rule: broken at 1 degree, safe rule after level 0
E0 old rule: broken at 1 degree, safe rule after level 1
E0 old rule: broken at 1 degree, safe rule after level 2
E0 C++ rule: broken at 1 degree, old-rule c after level 0
E0 C++ rule: broken at 1 degree, old-rule c after level 1
E0 C++ rule: broken at 1 degree, old-rule c after level 2
pilot key-off: wrong voxels at or above the cut
pilot key-off: answers at or above the cut that are wrong
